leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Apply the & selector to style nested elements within a parent selector
Construct CSS rules using @nest to target specific descendant relationships
Configure nested selectors to override inherited styles from parent elements
Implement nesting to organize related styles within a single rule block
Manipulate nested selectors to create hover and focus states for child elements
Integrate nesting with pseudo-classes to style elements based on their parent state
Update existing CSS code by refactoring flat selectors into nested structures
